said.text: Every child in this city deserves to walk into school without fear of being harassed or intimidated, and today we delivered that. … Whether you're in 2K or high school, you should be able to get into and out of your school without being grabbed or having epithets hurled at you, and this bill makes sure there's a clear, public plan to keep students safe while fully protecting every New Yorker's right to protest.

did.text: Voted Yes on Int 0929-2026, requiring a transparency report on NYPD security perimeters adjacent to educational facilities. Passed 39–10.

whyNote: The Council's release associates Council Member Dinowitz's statement with Int 929-A, the bill this vote passed; he voted yes. The ellipsis omits a sentence of thanks to the Speaker; the full statement is at the source link.
